classification_detail: Fully proved. Both directions of the equivalence (uniform continuity on (0,1) iff difference quotient condition) are proven zero-sorry. Direction (b)=>(a) is a clean direct proof via delta=epsilon/N. Direction (a)=>(b) requires showing UC on (0,1) implies boundedness (since (0,1) is totally bounded), using TotallyBounded.image and isUniformEmbedding_subtype_val to transfer total boundedness to the subtype.
key_lemmas: unifContOn01_bounded: UC on (0,1) implies f is bounded (via TotallyBounded.image)
